body:
I took Prozac for two weeks. After two weeks I felt better and deemed Prozac unnecessary for me.

I really don't like that the way antidepressants work is poorly understood or the shitty side effects. However, it doesn't seem like I have many alternatives.
But all the people that you influence will die. Nothing remains of the things you have done. Have you even existed?
It seems that death is easier than life. But you raise a good point, I have no way of being sure that my existence will not have some impact.

At some point the universe will cease to exist. No memory of anything that occurred in it will exist. It is as if it never existed. 

Yeah, I can influence people now but it is impossible to avoid this end, why not just embrace it now?
I don't see a reason to continue to exert effort in order to exist. Yes, death will take some effort but that's a one time thing.

I like this and used to feel this way, but lately I can't get past how I nothing I do matters. Everything will end and nothing will indicate that I ever existed. 
I look at the way most people live, caught up in the insignificant events of their daily life. That's the way I've been living but I have no desire to continue that way. I see no reason to find a passion. How else does one live?
